Priya (CSM): FYI team — Citrine QBR moved up to Tue 10:00 PT. Urgent: their token burn spiked after an embedding ingestion change. Need a short 7/30-day forecast, risk assessment for renewal, and quick mitigation suggestions we can run through in the QBR.

BillingBot: ALERT: Citrine Corp crossed 78% of monthly soft spend. Current window tokens: 1,045,002 (+188% vs prior 30d). Dashboard: https://app.redwood.io/accounts/citrine/usage

Leo (FinOps): Acknowledge. I'll produce a conservative/optimistic 30d forecast and a sensitivity table for batching effects. Quick question: is the spike steady or bursty? That affects peak provisioning.

Sam (Onboarding): From logs it's bursty — lots of parallel indexing jobs after their onboarding script ran. We pushed a temporary ingest pool yesterday to avoid failures.

Maya (Product Eng): Short-term tech controls: reduce parallel_workers on the client, set max_batch_size=64, and enable KV prefix caching for identical vectors. Medium-term: suggest switching to int8 embedding variant.

Leo (FinOps): Initial back-of-envelope forecast: last 7d avg/day = 95k tokens -> baseline 30d = 2.85M tokens. With current ingestion pattern projected = ~4.1M tokens (+260% month-over-month). If batching + off-peak rollouts are applied, expected reduction ~25-35%.

Priya (CSM): Can you paste the query you used for the chart so I can include it in the deck? Short bullets only.

Leo (FinOps): SQL I used:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_Citrine' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```

Priya (CSM): Nice. For the QBR we want: 1) current state + spike cause 2) 30d forecast (conservative/optimistic) 3) recommended mitigations + owners. I'll draft the slide.

Maya (Product Eng): Example client config snippet to recommend:
```yaml
ingest:
  max_batch_size: 64
  parallel_workers: 2
  schedule: "00:00-06:00 UTC"
  model: "embed-7b-int8"
```

Sam (Onboarding): I'll propose a 30-min enablement to walk through SDK batching and show quick code diffs. Can do next Thu or Fri. Also checking if Citrine's SLA requires near-real-time indexing.

Leo (FinOps): I'll upload two charts (7d/30d) and sensitivity table by Mon 4pm PT. Conservative forecast = +80% mo/mo, optimistic (with mitigations) = +15% mo/mo.

Priya (CSM): Owners: Leo -> numbers + charts; Maya -> runbook + config; Sam -> enablement invite + SLA check. I'll own the renewal-risk narrative. Goal: keep renewal categorized as green/low-risk in the QBR; if mitigations not feasible, mark "cost activation risk".

BillingBot: REMINDER: next billing cycle for Citrine starts in 5 days. Auto-notify threshold at 90% enabled.

Sam (Onboarding): Reached out to Citrine for scheduling. They prefer Fri AM but said they'll confirm.

Priya (CSM): Great. I'll draft slide + one-pager remediation and ping folks for review. Add :thumbsup: if you can't attend the review meeting.

Leo (FinOps): :thumbsup: will have charts by Monday.

Maya (Product Eng): :thumbsup: will add runbook.

(End of thread)
